form.instructions:
Please complete the form with your assessment of the likely conditions for the water sports session - you need to complete ALL fields.
The risk assessment will respond with the estimated risk status for the session and may suggest mitigation actions to reduce risks.
form.red_response: SEEK ADVICE ... check with a club official before proceeding with the session
form.amber_response: Go ahead WITH CARE ... consider the mitigation strategies listed below
form.green_response: Go ahead ... no risk mitigation actions required for today's sailing session
form.abandoning: Be prepared to ABANDON the session if conditions deteriorate.  Inform all safety boats that the race is abandoned. If the safety boats are overwhelmed by the no. of capsized boats, instruct them to leave boats and bring crews ashore.  Check that all boats/crews are safely ashore - if there are missing boats instruct the safety boats to search for them by giving each safety boat a specific area to search.  Do not bring safety boats ashore until all sailors are accounted for.
